Class BufferSvgExporter

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.export.BufferSvgExporter
public final class BufferSvgExporter extends Object
Exports a Buffer to an SVG in the same spirit as Rich's Console.export_svg.

This exporter treats the buffer as a fixed-width grid of cells and generates:

  • CSS classes for unique Styles
  • Background rectangles for runs with a background color (including Modifier.REVERSED)
  • Text nodes clipped per line for crisp rendering

Notes

  • This is a pure string export; it does not require a backend.
  • Colors are resolved via Color.toRgb() plus a simple theme fallback.
